# duploai_admin_ai_agent (Data Source)

Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk AI Agent — an external AI service or model the help desk can invoke to perform automated tasks. Agents are assigned to personas, which determine where they are available.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an AI agent by ID.
data "duploai_admin_ai_agent" "example" {
  id = "<object-id>"
}

output "name" {
  value = data.duploai_admin_ai_agent.example.name
}

output "endpoint" {
  value = data.duploai_admin_ai_agent.example.endpoint
}

output "is_active" {
  value = data.duploai_admin_ai_agent.example.is_active
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the object to look up.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the agent was created (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the agent.
- `does_support_streaming` (Boolean) Whether the agent supports streaming (Server-Sent Events) responses.
- `endpoint` (String) Absolute URL of the HTTP(S) endpoint the help desk calls to invoke this agent. Must be a well-formed absolute URL.
- `endpoint_details` (Attributes) Additional configuration for invoking the agent endpoint. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--endpoint_details))
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the agent is active and available for use. Defaults to active when omitted.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Free-form key/value configuration for the agent (e.g. model, maxTokens, systemPrompt).
- `name` (String) Name of the AI agent.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the agent was last updated (RFC 3339).
- `version` (Number) Version counter, incremented on each update.

<a id="nestedatt--endpoint_details"></a>
### Nested Schema for `endpoint_details`

Read-Only:

- `http_headers` (Map of String) HTTP headers sent when invoking the agent.
- `method` (String) HTTP method used to invoke the agent.
- `path` (String) Path the help desk invokes the agent on.
